town_description: Kanker (Uttar Bastar Kanker) is the district headquarters town of Kanker district in southern Chhattisgarh, on the Doodh river. Its main hill landmark, Gadiya Mountain (Kila Dongri), holds caves, a lake, and old hilltop shrines, and its oldest documented temple is the Shivani Maa temple, one of Kanker's oldest.
